title: fanoutqa: Where are the six marathon races in the world marathon majors hosted, and when was each first held? (ca2bf128869985f6)

chat_history.content: Where are the six marathon races in the world marathon majors hosted, and when was each first held?

content.content:
The user asks: "Where are the six marathon races in the world marathon majors hosted, and when was each first held?" They want location (city/country) and the year each first held. The six World Marathon Majors: Tokyo, Boston, London, Berlin, Chicago, New York City. Provide location and first year. Need accurate info. Could answer from knowledge. Provide a table: Marathon, Host City, Country, First Held (year). Provide brief notes. No need external lookup; I know approximate years: Boston Marathon first held 1897; New York City Marathon first held 1970; Chicago Marathon first held 1977; London Marathon first held 1981; Berlin Marathon first held 1974; Tokyo Marathon first held 2007 (the modern Tokyo Marathon, but there was a predecessor? The World Marathon Majors include Tokyo Marathon (started 2007). Provide info.

Thus answer.

content:
**World Marathon Majors – Host Cities & Inaugural Years**

| Major | Host City (Country) | Year of First Edition* |
|-------|---------------------|------------------------|
| **Boston Marathon** | Boston, United States | **1897** |
| **London Marathon** | London, United Kingdom | **1981** |
| **Berlin Marathon** | Berlin, Germany | **1974** |
| **Chicago Marathon** | Chicago, United States | **1977** |
| **New York City Marathon** | New York City, United States | **1970** |
| **Tokyo Marathon** | Tokyo, Japan | **2007** |

\*The “first edition” refers to the inaugural race that is recognized as the modern, city‑wide marathon that later became part of the World Marathon Majors series.  

### Quick notes on each inaugural race  

- **Boston Marathon (1897)** – Started by the Boston Athletic Association; it is the world’s oldest annual marathon.  
- **London Marathon (1981)** – Conceived by athlete Chris Brasher and former Olympic champion John Disley; the inaugural run attracted 7,500 participants.  
- **Berlin Marathon (1974)** – Began as the “West German Championships” in the Cold‑War era; it has become famous for its fast, flat course and numerous world‑record performances.  
- **Chicago Marathon (1977)** – First run as the “Mayor Daley Marathon” with only 2,100 finishers; it grew quickly into a major international event.  
- **New York City Marathon (1970)** – Started with just 127 runners who ran the five boroughs on a looped course in Central Park; it moved to its current five‑borough route in 1976.  
- **Tokyo Marathon (2007)** – Launched as a mass‑participation event (the earlier “Tokyo International Marathon” for elite runners ran from 1981‑2006); the 2007 edition marked the start of the city’s open‑entry marathon that now belongs to the Majors.

These six races together form the **World Marathon Majors** series, the premier circuit of elite and mass‑participation marathons worldwide.
